Achievements

Version

8.60
June 30, 2010
Summer Update 2010

Status

Active

Achievements are extra goals that can be accomplished while playing Tibia, by doing quests, discovering secret places or doing some extraordinary things. When you gain an achievement, you will receive the following message:
Congratulations! You earned the achievement "Achievement".

You can show off five of your most impressive achievements on your character page and compare them to others on the Highscores. In order to display your achievements, login on the Tibia website, and go to the edit character section.

Although achievements are character-based, achievements unlocked by any character on the same account can be displayed on any of those characters' information pages. The achievement points, however, are counted individually to every character.

Achievements yield a certain number of points depending on their grade of difficulty:

Grade 1 1-3 points
Grade 2 4-6 points
Grade 3 7-9 points
Grade 4 10 points


The Tibia website section of achievements shows the regular achievements that can be obtained through completing quests and tasks and the like. There are also "secret" achievements , which players discover themselves; at the bottom of the tibia website section of achievements there is a paragraph about available secret achievements; most of these are harder to achieve than regular achievements.

Here is the list of almost all achievements (all common ones and most secret), all of them with spoilers of how to get it. If you want to discover the achievements for yourself, avoid reading ahead. There is a thread on the official forums where players discuss how to get achievements and possible undiscovered achievements. The list of unknown achievements can be found in the Achievements/Unknown page.


  • This list includes 368 common and 202 / 203 secret achievements (570 out of 571 total discovered achievements).
  • The theoretical maximum points one can have is 1506. Excluding coinciding achievements (e.g Marid Ally and Efreet Ally), the maximum is 1461. (Achievements with unverified amounts of points are not considered in these numbers.)

Castlemania 1 2

✓ ✓ 5 June 30, 2010 You have an eye for suspicious places and love to read other people's diaries, especially those with vampire stories in it. You're also a dedicated token collector and explorer. Respect! Obtainable by finishing the Blood Brothers Quest, marking all 8 spots on Julius' Map, finishing the Vampire Hunter Quest, picking up the Blood Skull, Blood Goblet and all missing diary pages (6 pieces). Note: You can redo your map by saying map, then yes to Julius.

✗ ✗ 1 June 30, 2010 Lalalala... you now know the cult's hymn sung in Liberty Bay by heart. Not that hard, considering that it mainly consists of two notes and repetitive lyrics. Obtainable by learning all four Music Sheets.
The Milkman 3 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 Who's the milkman? You are! Obtainable by completing the daily task An Uneasy Alliance Quest - Task 1 - Milk Delivery.
Vive la Resistance 4 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 You've always been a rebel - admit it! Supplying prisoners, caring for outcasts, stealing from the rich and giving to the poor - no wait, that was another story. Obtainable by finishing the Daily Task of Children of the Revolution Quest.
Culinary Master 5 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 Simple hams and bread merely make you laugh. You're the master of the extra-ordinaire, melter of cheese, fryer of bat wings and shaker of shakes. Delicious! Obtainable by cooking all the dishes in Hot Cuisine Quest twice.

Note for old characters: You need to cook the 4 new dishes introduced in the Summer Update 2010 twice and cook the previous 10 again if you did that before the update in order to get this achievement.

Shell Seeker 6 1

✓ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 You found a hundred beautiful pearls in large sea shells. By now that necklace should be finished - and hopefully you didn't get your fingers squeezed too often during the process. Obtainable by finding 100 Giant Shimmering Pearls of any colour out of closed large seashells.
Backpack Tourist 7 1

✓ ✗ 1 June 30, 2010 If someone lost a random thing in a random place, you're probably a good person to ask and go find it, even if you don't know what and where. Obtainable by giving back to Sam his old backpack (Sam's Old Backpack Quest).
Dread Lord 8 3

✓ ✓ 8 June 30, 2010 You don't care for rules that others set up and shape the world to your liking. Having left behind meaningless conventions and morals, you prize only the power you wield. You're a master of your fate and battle to cleanse the world. Obtainable by getting the rank of Dread Lord of the Brotherhood of Bones faction in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest.
Lord Protector 9 3

✓ ✓ 8 June 30, 2010 You proved yourself - not only in your dreams - and possess a strong and spiritual mind. Your valorous fight against demons and the undead plague has granted you the highest and most respected rank among the Nightmare Knights. Obtainable by getting the rank of Lord Protector of the Nightmare Knights faction in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest.
Nightmare Knight 10 1

✗ ✓ 1 June 30, 2010 You follow the path of dreams and that of responsibility without self-centered power. Free from greed and selfishness, you help others without expecting a reward. Obtainable by joining to the Nightmare Knights in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest.
Bone Brother 11 1

✗ ✓ 1 June 30, 2010 You've joined the undead bone brothers - making death your enemy and your weapon as well. Devouring what's weak and leaving space for what's strong is your primary goal. Obtainable by joining to the Brotherhood of Bones in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest.
Blessed! 12 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 You travelled the world for an almost meaningless prayer - but at least you don't have to do that again and can get a new blessed stake in the blink of an eye. Obtainable by finishing The Blessed Stake Quest. Note: you don't need to obtain a second blessed wooden stake from Chondur: just speak with him about it until he says "(...) Listen, child, if you bring me a wooden stake, I'll bless it for you. <chuckles>".
Recognised Trader 13 1

✗ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 You're a talented merchant who's able to handle wares with care, finds good offers and digs up rares every now and then. Never late to complete an order, you're a reliable trader - at least in Rashid's eyes. Obtainable by finishing the The Travelling Trader Quest.
Fountain of Life 14 1

✓ ✓ 1 June 30, 2010 You found and took a sip from the Fountain of Life. Thought it didn't grant you eternal life, you feel changed and somehow at peace. Obtainable by drinking from the fountain of life in pits of inferno's entrance here (32806, 32321, 11).
Lord of the Elements (Achievement) 15 2

✗ ✓ 5 June 30, 2010 You travelled the surreal realm of the elemental spheres, summoned and slayed the Lord of the Elements, all in order to retrieve neutral matter. And as brave as you were, you couldn't have done it without your team! Obtainable by finishing The Elemental Spheres Quest.
Beach Tamer 16 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 You re-enacted the Taming of the Shrew on a beach setting and proved that you can handle capricious girls quite well. With or without fish tails. Obtainable by completing The Mermaid Marina Quest.
Follower of Azerus 17 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 When you do something, you do it right. You have an opinion and you stand by it - and no one will be able to convince you otherwise. On a sidenote, you're a bit on the brutal and war-oriented side, but that's not a bad thing, is it? Obtainable by completing mission 9 In Service of Yalahar Quest when you follow all of Yalahari (NPC)'s instructions. Note: If you finish one or some missions by following Palimuth's instructions you will get the Turncoat achievement instead.
Follower of Palimuth 18 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 You're a peacekeeper and listen to what the small people have to say. You've made up your mind and know who to help and for which reasons - and you do it consistently. Your war is fought with reason rather than weapons. Obtainable by completing mission 9 of In Service of Yalahar Quest when you follow all of Palimuth's instructions. Note: If you finish one or some missions by following Yalahari (NPC)'s instructions you will get the Turncoat achievement instead.
Elite Hunter 19 2

✗ ✓ 5 June 30, 2010 You jump at every opportunity for a hunting challenge that's offered to you and carry out those tasks with deadly precision. You're a hunter at heart and a valuable member of the Paw & Fur Society. Obtainable by getting the rank of Elite Hunter in the Killing in the Name of... Quest, Paw and Fur Ranks.
Huntsman (Achievement) 20 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 You're familiar with hunting tasks and have carried out quite a few already. A bright career as hunter for the Paw & Fur society lies ahead! Obtainable by getting the rank of Huntsman in the Killing in the Name of... Quest, Paw and Fur Ranks.
Passionate Kisser 21 1

✗ ✗ 3 June 30, 2010 For you, a kiss is more than a simple touch of lips. You kiss maidens and deadbeats alike with unmatched affection and faced death and rebirth through the kiss of the banshee queen. Lucky are those who get to share such an intimate moment with you! Obtainable by finishing the Kissing a Pig Quest.
Top AVIN Agent 22 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 You've proven yourself as a worthy member of the 'family' and successfully carried out numerous spy missions for your 'uncle' to support the Venorean traders and their goals. Obtainable by finishing the Secret Service Quest for the AVIN faction.
Top CGB Agent 23 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 Girl power! Whether you're female or not, you've proven absolute loyalty and the willingness to put your life at stake for the girls brigade of Carlin. Obtainable by finishing the Secret Service Quest for the CGB faction.
Top TBI Agent 24 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 Conspiracies and open secrets are your daily bread. You've shown loyalty to the Thaian crown through your courage when facing enemies and completing spy missions. You're an excellent field agent of the TBI. Obtainable by finishing the Secret Service Quest for the TBI faction.
Secret Agent 25 1

✗ ✗ 1 June 30, 2010 Pack your spy gear and get ready for some dangerous missions in service of a secret agency. You've shown you want to - but can you really do it? Time will tell. Obtainable by starting the Secret Service Quest.
Golem in the Gears 26 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 You're an aspiring mago-mechanic. Science and magic work well together in your eyes - and even though you probably delivered countless wrong charges while working for Telas, you might just have enough knowledge to build your own golem now. Obtainable by completing Shadows of Yalahar Quest.
Poet Laureate 27 1

✓ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 Poems, verses, songs and rhymes you've recited many times. You have passed the cryptic door, raconteur of ancient lore. Even elves you've left impressed, so it seems you're truly blessed. Obtainable by finishing mission 3 of Kissing a Pig Quest, finding the poem about the ancient tombs at the Great Pyramid in Ankrahmun, and then entering the first "endless" door of Dipthrah's chambers (Mountain Tomb).
Minstrel 28 1

✓ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 You can handle any music instrument you're given - and actually manage to produce a pleasant sound with it. You're a welcome guest and entertainer in most taverns. Obtainable by playing Musical Instruments 500 times and by solving the instruments puzzle in Vashresamun's antechamber.
Friend of the Apes 29 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 You know Banuta like the back of your hand and are good at destroying caskets and urns. The sight of giant footprints doesn't keep you from exploring unknown areas either. Obtainable by finishing The Ape City Quest.
Territorial 30 1

✓ ✓ 1 June 30, 2010 Your map is your friend — always in your back pocket and covered with countless marks of interesting and useful locations. One could say that you might be lost without it — but luckily there's no way to take it from you. Obtainable by asking Guide Alexena (Carlin), Guide Behil (Darashia), Guide Davina (Liberty Bay), Guide Edna (Yalahar), Guide Elena (Venore), Guide Jonathan (Edron), Guide Luke (Thais), Guide Rahlkora (Ankrahmun), Guide Thelandil (Ab'dendriel), and Guide Tiko (Port Hope) to mark your automap.
Marid Ally 31 1

✗ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 You've proven to be a valuable ally to the Marid, and Gabel welcomed you to trade with Haroun and Nah'Bob whenever you want to. Though the Djinn war has still not ended, the Marid can't fail with you on their side. Obtainable by finishing The Djinn War - Marid Faction.
Efreet Ally 32 1

✗ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 Even though the Efreet welcomed you only reluctantly and viewed you as "only a human" for quite some time, you managed to impress Malor and gained his respect and trade options with the green djinns. Obtainable by finishing The Djinn War - Efreet Faction.
Lucid Dreamer 33 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 Dreams - are your reality? Strange visions, ticking clocks, going to bed and waking up somewhere completely else - that was some trip, but you're almost sure you actually did enjoy it. Obtainable by finishing the Mission 4 of Dreamer's Challenge Quest.
Explorer 34 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 You've been to places most people don't even know the names of. Collecting botanic, zoologic and ectoplasmic samples is your daily business and you're always prepared to discover new horizons. Obtainable by completing the second explorer's mission, The Spectral Dress, in The Explorer Society Quest.
Sea Scout 35 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 Not even the hostile underwater environment stops you from doing your duty for the Explorer Society. Scouting the Quara realm is a piece of cake for you. Obtainable by doing The Undersea Kingdom and The Frozen Trench missions in The Explorer Society Quest.
Bearhugger 37 1

✗ ✓ 1 June 30, 2010 Warm, furry and cuddly - though that same bear you just hugged would probably rip you into pieces if he had been conscious, he reminded you of that old teddy bear which always slept in your bed when you were still small. Obtainable by completing the second mission in the Barbarian Test Quest.
Ghostwhisperer 38 1

✗ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 You don't hunt them, you talk to them. You know that ghosts might keep secrets that have been long lost among the living, and you're skilled at talking them into revealing them to you. Obtainable by:
  • Talking to Ghost of a Priest in the 4th mission of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest;
  • Talking to A Wandering Soul in the 5th mission of the Blood Brothers Quest; and
  • Talking to A Restless Soul in the Formorgar Mines 1 mission of the Ice Islands Quest.
Animal Activist 39 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 You have a soft spot for little, weak animals, and you do everything in your power to protect them - even if you probably eat dragons for breakfast. Obtainable by doing The Ice Islands Quest - Nibelor 3: Artful Sabotage AND Meriana Quest - Tortoise Egg from Nargor Mission.
Note: If you did both these missions and still haven't received the achievement, kill some Huskies in Svargrond and then pay your fine to Iskan.
Honorary Barbarian 40 1

✗ ✓ 1 June 30, 2010 You've hugged bears, pushed mammoths and proved your drinking skills. And even though you have a slight hangover, a partially fractured rib and some greasy hair on your tongue, you're quite proud to call yourself a honorary barbarian from now on. Obtainable by finishing the Barbarian Test Quest.
High Inquisitor 41 2

✗ ✓ 5 June 30, 2010 You're the one who poses the questions around here, and you know how to get the answers you want to hear. Besides, you're a famous exorcist and slay a few vampires and demons here and there. You and your stake are a perfect team. Obtainable by finishing The Inquisition Quest.
Worm Whacker 42 1

✓ ✗ 1 June 30, 2010 Weehee! Whack those worms! You sure know how to handle a big hammer. Obtainable by completing mission 4 of the Isle of Evil Quest.
King Tibianus Fan 43 1

✗ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 You're not sure what it is, but you feel drawn to royalty. Your knees are always a bit grazed from crawling around in front of thrones and you love hanging out in castles. Maybe you should consider applying as a guard? Obtainable by finishing The Isle of Evil Quest.
Just in Time 44 1

✗ ✓ 1 June 30, 2010 You're a fast runner and are good at delivering wares which are bound to decay just in the nick of time, even if you can't use any means of transportation or if your hands get cold or smelly in the process. Obtainable by finishing The Ice Delivery mission of The Explorer Society Quest and by finishing The Wednesday Mission of The Travelling Trader Quest.
Perfect Fool 45 1

✗ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 You love playing jokes on others and tricking them into looking a little silly. Wagging tongues say that the moment of realisation in your victims' eyes is the reward you feed on, but you're probably just kidding and having fun with them... right?? Obtainable by doing What a foolish Quest.
Mathemagician 46 1

✗ ✓ 1 June 30, 2010 Sometimes the biggest secrets of life can have a simple solution. Obtainable by talking with "A Prisoner" in Paradox Tower Quest.
Archpostman 47 1

✗ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 Delivering letters and parcels has always been a secret passion of yours, and now you can officially put on your blue hat, blow your post horn and do what you like to do most. Beware of dogs! Obtainable by finishing The Postman Missions Quest.
Matchmaker 48 1

✗ ✗ 1 June 30, 2010 You don't believe in romance to be a coincidence or in love at first sight. In fact - love potions, bouquets of flowers and cheesy poems do the trick much better than ever could. Keep those hormones flowing! Obtainable by completing The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest - Mission 3: Love's a Wicked Game, or by completing The Shattered Isles Quest - Breaking the Spell (Access to Laguna Islands).
His True Face 49 1

✓ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 You're one of the few Tibians who Armenius chose to actually show his true face to - and he made you fight him. Either that means you're very lucky or very unlucky, but one thing's for sure - it's extremely rare. There's a small chance of getting this achievement during the mission 3 of the Blood Brothers Quest: if you're lucky, he teleports you to his basement when you leave his tavern after talking to him. This can also happen when entering or leaving the bar after completing the mission.
Razing! 50 3

✓ ✗ 7 June 30, 2010 People with sharp canine teeth better beware of you, especially at nighttime, or they might find a stake between their ribs. You're a merciless vampire hunter and have gathered numerous tokens as proof. Obtained by getting the rank of "Razing!" in the Vampire Hunter Quest by handing in 100 Vampire Lord Tokens.
Master Thief 51 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 Robbing, inviting yourself to VIP parties, faking contracts and pretending to be someone else - you're a jack of all trades when it comes to illegal activities. You take no prisoners, except for the occasional goldfish now and then. Obtainable by finishing The Thieves Guild Quest.
Amateur Actor 52 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 You helped bringing Princess Buttercup, Doctor Dumbness and Lucky the Wonder Dog to life - and will probably dream of them tonight, since you memorised your lines perfectly. What a .. special piece of.. screenplay. Obtainable by completing Mission 4 of The Thieves Guild Quest.
Scrapper 53 1

✗ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 You put out the Spirit of Fire's flames in the arena of Svargrond. Arena fights are for you - fair, square, with simple rules and one-on-one battles. Obtainable by finishing the Barbarian Arena Quest in the Scrapper difficulty.
Greenhorn 54 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 You wiped out Orcus the Cruel in the Arena of Svargrond. You're still a bit green behind the ears, but there's some great potential. Obtainable by finishing the Barbarian Arena Quest in the Greenhorn difficulty.
Warlord of Svargrond 55 2

✗ ✓ 5 June 30, 2010 You sent the Obliverator into oblivion in the arena of Svargrond and defeated nine other dangerous enemies on the way. All hail the Warlord of Svargrond! Obtainable by finishing the Barbarian Arena Quest in the Warlord difficulty.
Herbicide 56 3

✓ ✓ 8 June 30, 2010 You're one of the brave heroes to face and defeat the mysterious demon oak and all the critters it threw in your face. Wielding your blessed axe no tree dares stand in your way - demonic or not. Obtainable by completing The Demon Oak Quest.
Annihilator 57 2

✗ ✓ 5 June 30, 2010 You've daringly jumped into the infamous Annihilator and survived - taking home fame, glory and your reward. Obtainable by finishing The Annihilator Quest.
Master of the Nexus 58 2

✗ ✓ 6 June 30, 2010 You were able to fight your way through the countless hordes in the Demon Forge. Once more you proved that nothing is impossible. Obtainable by finishing The Inquisition Quest.
Talented Dancer 59 1

✗ ✓ 1 June 30, 2010 You're a lord or lady of the dance - and not afraid to use your skills to impress tribal gods. One step to the left, one jump to the right, twist and shout! Obtainable by completing Mission 3 of Unnatural Selection Quest.
Allow Cookies? 60 1

✗ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 With a perfectly harmless smile you fooled all of those wisecrackers into eating your exploding cookies. Consider a boy or girl scout outfit next time to make the trick even better. Obtainable by delivering Exploding Cookies to Avar Tar, Simon the Beggar, Ariella, Lorbas, Markwin, Hjaern, Wyda, Hairycles and Orc King during What a Foolish Quest - Mission 10 - A Sweet Surprise. It is not necessary to deliver an exploding cookie to Yaman or Nah'Bob in order to get this achievement.
Ruthless 61 2

✗ ✓ 5 June 30, 2010 You've touched all thrones of the Ruthless Seven and absorbed some of their evil spirit. It may have changed you forever. Obtainable by finishing The Pits of Inferno Quest.
Champion of Chazorai 62 2

✗ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 You won the merciless 2 vs. 2 team tournament on the Isle of Strife and wiped out wave after wave of fearsome opponents. Death or victory - you certainly chose the latter. Obtainable by finishing mission 9 of The New Frontier Quest.
Wayfarer 63 1

✓ ✓ 3 June 30, 2010 Dragon dreams are golden. Obtainable by doing 9th mission of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest.
Waverider 64 1

✓ ✗ 2 June 30, 2010 One thing's for sure: You definitely love swimming. Hanging out on the beach with your friends, having ice cream and playing beach ball is splashingly good fun! Obtainable by swimming 100,000 tiles. NOTE: it is possible to gain this achievement in Rookgaard.
Rockstar 65 1

✓ ✗ 3 June 30, 2010 Music just comes to you naturally. You feel comfortable on any stage, at any time, and secretly hope that someday you will be able to defeat your foes by playing music only. Rock on! Obtainable by playing Musical Instruments 10,000 times. You can play different instruments and log out without resetting the counter.
Allowance Collector 66 1

✓ ✗ 2 June 30, 2010 You certainly have your ways when it comes to acquiring money. Many of them are pink and paved with broken fragments of porcelain. Obtainable by breaking 50 Piggy Banks.
High-Flyer 67 2

✓ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 The breeze in your hair, your fingers clutching the rim of your carpet - that's how you like to travel. Faster! Higher! And a looping every now and then. Obtainable by travelling by Magic Carpet 1000 times. Tip: Edron - Darashia is the cheapest route: 40 gp per trip (30 gp if you have done the Postman Quest).
Clay Fighter 68 1

✓ ✗ 3 June 30, 2010 You love getting your hands wet and dirty - and covered with clay. Your perfect sculpture of Brog, the raging Titan is your true masterpiece. Obtainable by making a Pretty Clay Statue from a Clay Lump.
Masquerader 69 1

✓ ✗ 3 June 30, 2010 You probably don't know anymore how you really look like - usually when you look into a mirror, some kind of monster stares back at you. On the other hand - maybe that's an improvement? Obtainable by using 100 Costume Bags of Stan.
Deep Sea Diver 70 2

✓ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 Under the sea - might not be your natural living space, but you're feeling quite comfortable on the ocean floor. Quara don't scare you anymore and sometimes you sleep with your helmet of the deep still equipped. Obtainable by walking 1,000,000 steps underwater. Confirmed working tiles are Ocean Floor, underwater ‎Marble Floor and underwater Sandstone Floor. Lava crack tiles in the Sea Serpent Area are not counted, as those are also used on land. Tip: use a Coconut Shrimp Bake to increase your underwater walking speed before attempting this achievement.
Firewalker 71 2

✓ ✗ 4 June 30, 2010 Running barefoot across ember is not for you! You do it the elegant way. Yet, you're kind of drawn to fire and warm surroundings in general - you like it hot! This achievement can be gotten by walking 1,000,000 tiles on fire while wearing Firewalker Boots. Note that any type of fire field will work for this achievement (even player-made ones) as long as the fields inflict damage for the boots to block.
Here, Fishy Fishy! 72 1

✓ ✗ 1 June 30, 2010 Ah, the smell of the sea! Standing at the shore and casting a line is one of your favourite activities. For you, fishing is relaxing - and at the same time, providing easy food. Perfect! Obtainable by fishing 1000 Fish or, during the Twisted Waters World Change, Fishbones. Note: Ice Fishing doesn't count.
Green Thumb 73 2

✓ ✗ 4 June 30, 2010 If someone gives you seeds, you usually grow a beautiful plant from it within a few days. You like your house green and decorated with flowers. Probably you also talk to them. Obtainable by growing 100 fully developed flowers in Flower Pots. Tip: you can reuse pots by letting the flower in it wither to then finally water it again. The flower will return to stage 2 and can then be grown to stage 3 again.
Potion Addict 74 2

✓ ✗ 4 June 30, 2010 Your local magic trader considers you one of his best customers - you usually buy large stocks of potions so you won't wake up in the middle of the night craving for more. Yet, you always seem to run out of them too fast. Cheers! Obtainable by drinking 100,000 potions that regenerate mana, 100,000 potions that regenerate health or 100,000 potions that regenerate both mana and health points.
Ice Sculptor 75 1

✓ ✗ 3 June 30, 2010 You love to hang out in cold surroundings and consider ice the best material to be shaped. What a waste to use ice cubes for drinks when you can create a beautiful mammoth statue from it! Obtainable by sculpting an Ice Mammoth from Ice Cubes by using an Obsidian Knife on it.
Interior Decorator 76 2

✓ ✗ 4 June 30, 2010 Your home is your castle - and the furniture in it is just as important. Your friends ask for your advice when decorating their houses and your probably own every statue, rack and bed there is. Since April 2016 (Update 10.92), this achievement is obtained by making 1000 purchases of Furniture Kits. Note that you’ll have to make 1000 individual furniture kit purchases — making 10 purchases of 100 furniture kits each, for example, would only count as 10 purchases. Hint: The cheapest way to do this is to buy 1000 Troughs (7 gp each).
Before April 2016, you had to use 1000 Furniture Packages to obtain this achievement.
Jinx 77 1

✓ ✗ 2 June 30, 2010 Sometimes you feel there's a gremlin in there. So many lottery tickets, so many blanks? That's just not fair! Share your misery with the world. Obtainable by opening 500 blank Lottery Tickets (winning tickets don't count).
Lucky Devil 78 2

✓ ✗ 4 June 30, 2010 That's almost too much luck for one person. If something's really, really rare - it probably falls into your lap sooner or later. Congratulations! To get this achievement you need to fish a Leviathan's Amulet from the corpse of a Water Elemental or Massive Water Elemental AND unrust a Golden Armor out of a Slightly Rusted Armor.

See also: Water Elemental/Fishing Statistics, Massive Water Elemental/Fishing Statistics, and Slightly Rusted Armor/Unrusting Statistics

Marblelous 79 1

✓ ✗ 3 June 30, 2010 You're an aspiring marble sculptor with promising skills - proven by the perfect little Tibiasula statue you shaped. One day you'll be really famous! Obtainable by making a Beautiful Marble Statue from a Piece of Marble Rock.
Party Animal 80 1

✓ ✗ 1 June 30, 2010 Oh my god, it's a paaaaaaaaaaaarty! You're always in for fun, friends and booze and love being the center of attention. There's endless reasons to celebrate! Woohoo! Obtainable by using a Party Trumpet or Party Hat 200 times. Note: A Party Hat is recommended since there is absolutely no delay in using it multiple times.
Fireworks in the Sky 81 1

✓ ✗ 2 June 30, 2010 You love the moment right before your rocket takes off and explodes into beautiful colours - not only on new year's eve! Obtainable by using 250 Fireworks Rockets on the floor (doesn't count if used in your backpack/container).
Quick as a Turtle 82 1

✓ ✓ 2 June 30, 2010 There... is... simply... no... better... way - than to travel on the back of a turtle. At least you get to enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Laguna. Obtainable by travelling by the sea turtle on Laguna Islands 2000 times. (about 25-30 min non-stop).
Polisher 83 2

✓ ✗ 4 June 30, 2010 If you see a rusty item, you can't resist polishing it. There's always a little flask of rust remover in your inventory – who knows, there might be a golden armor beneath all that dirt! Obtainable by successfully polishing a combined total of 1000 Rusty Armors, Rusty Helmets, Rusty Legs, and Rusty Shields. To do that, you need to use about 1500 Flasks of Rust Remover.
Ship's Kobold 84 2

✓ ✓ 4 June 30, 2010 You’ve probably never gotten seasick in your life — you love spending your free time on the ocean and covered quite a lot of miles with ships. Aren’t you glad you didn’t have to swim all that? Obtainable by travelling by ship around 1250 times.
Steampunked 85 1

✓ ✗ 2 June 30, 2010 Travelling with the dwarven steamboats through the underground rivers is your preferred way of crossing the lands. No pesky seagulls, and good beer on board! Obtainable by traveling by Steamship 100 times. The cheapest option is to travel between Kazordoon and Cormaya (160gp, or 150gp if you’ve completed The Postman Missions Quest) until you gain the achievement.
Vanity 86 1

Or maybe doing a quick check whether something's stuck in your teeth, perhaps? Obtainable by using Wall Mirrors 300 times. Note that getting the message Don't be so vain does not count towards the achievement, which is why being drunk in order to eliminate the possibility of this message appearing will save a lot of time. Also note that it is impossible to gain this achievement through the use of wall mirrors that spawn as objects in-game, such as the one above the Swamp Troll Cave near Venore.
